# 📋 Standard Academic Research Proposal Template

Use this structured template when writing research proposals for university thesis projects, grant applications, or research fellowships.

---

```markdown
# [Title of Research Project]

**Principal Investigator**: [Your Name]  
**Institution / Department**: [Department Name, University]  
**Date**: [YYYY-MM-DD]  

---

## 1. Executive Summary / Abstract
[Write a 250-word summary highlighting the problem statement, primary research question, proposed methodology, and expected impact.]

## 2. Background & Problem Statement
- What is the real-world or theoretical problem?
- Why is current solution X inadequate?

## 3. Research Objectives & Questions
- **RO1**: To design...
- **RQ1**: How does parameter Y affect performance Z under condition W?

## 4. Literature Review Summary
[Briefly summarize 4-6 key benchmark studies and pinpoint the exact research gap.]

## 5. Proposed Methodology
- **Data Collection**: [Datasets, sampling method]
- **Model / Experimental Setup**: [Algorithms, metrics, hardware]
- **Validation**: [K-fold cross-validation, baseline comparisons]

## 6. Timeline & Milestones (Gantt Chart)
| Month | Task / Milestone |
| :--- | :--- |
| Month 1-2 | Data collection and preprocessing pipeline |
| Month 3-4 | Model design and baseline training |
| Month 5 | Evaluation and paper drafting |

## 7. References (BibTeX / APA)
```
